description:
T1- X2 Ash trees leaning from adjacent woodland and threatening bar in North West corner. ADB present, Ivy clad. Section fell close to ground level and stack timber in woods
T2- X1 Oak tree, reduce back branches overhanging score board by 3 metres to clear obstruction.
T3- X1 Oak tree, reduce back by 3 metres to minimise the overhang of the pitch.
T4- X1 Ash tree, reduce back by 3 metres to minimise the overhang of the pitch.
T5- X1 Ash tree, Ivy Clad mess, cut back to boundary fence to minimise debris dropping on spectators.
T6- X1 Oak tree, pocket of decay at the base. Reduce branches by 2m that impede new floodlight.
T7- X1 Oak tree, previously had the lower canopy reduced. Reduce Upper canopy by 2.5m to balance and mitigate limb failure over spectators.
T8- X1 Oak tree, reduce branches by 2m that impede new floodlight.
T9- Lime tree, located in centre of car park, significant column of decay running down the main stem at approx 5m with unidentified FFB. Section fell to ground level & grind out stump.
